st: Into The Valley Of The Shadow
d: Drovers Run faces its biggest crisis ever, and only a massive cattle drove will save Drovers from financial ruin, but have they left it too late? The search for Ingrid continues and a massive grain silo explodes with disastrous consequences.
Laurel announces she’s staying in Edgemont; Jennifer discovers election ballots missing; Kevin confesses to a crush on Erin.
Mark and Laurel find an apartment; Anika tries to save her reputation; Chris’s attraction to Jennifer grows.
Gil creates a list of the “hottest” girls at A.C. McKinley and posts it on-line; Anika uses Bekka against Jennifer’s newspaper editorials.
Anika launches a personal attack on Jennifer – in which she goes too far; Laurel and Mark make up; Erin and Kevin become a couple.
Kat moves back home and tells Laurel to leave; Anika and Erin face suspension; Jen and Chris enter the same contest.
Laurel’s plans for a romantic dinner with Mark go awry; Shannon mistakenly reveals her secret; Derek returns from jail; full-scale war erupts between Anika and Erin.
Jen and Chris face a crisis in their just-begun relationship; Anika gets impeached; Mark’s new job complicates his life.
Anika announces her intention to transfer to another school; Craig reveals some unexpected feelings.
Jennifer and Shannon have a blowout; Kevin loses it when he sees Erin making a play for Mark; Kat learns that “Demonslayer” lives nearby.
Derek frightens Laurel, causing both Mark and Jennifer to cut him loose; Kat discovers the startling identity of Demonslayer; Josh tells Laurel how he feels about her.

t: Melrose Place: Hunka, Hunka Burnin Love
d: Peter fires Sydney after learning that she sold his house (which he had listed as a company asset) to pay the practice's debts. Peter has to move into Amanda's apartment.
Jane saves Jake and Alison from the fire. Jane apologizes for her outburst but later tries to seduce Billy to make the couple jealous.
Jane slashes Alison's tires. Jake catches Jane following Alison and him and orders her to stop stalking them. Jane files a restraining order against Jake.

t: Melrose Place: Young Doctors in Heat
d: Amanda and Peter continue to fight constantly. Peter decides to stay with Michael and Kimberly for a while.
Taylor reveals that she is the younger sister of Peter's late wife Beth. She hangs out with Peter while Amanda is away on a business trip, and helps him pick out a ring for her.
Marty and Jeannie put their plan into action to pit their rival clients against one another. Changes at Galweather promise trouble for Jeannie. Clyde is forced to work from Monica's home.

Marty deals with his newest clients, hip-hop clothing moguls Dre Collins and Lukas Frye, who have divergent attitudes and plans for their company, DollaHyde. Jeannie defines her new role. Clyde turns to Marty for help.

Marty and Jeannie launch a duplicitous plan to remove Lukas from DollaHyde. Clyde woos Marissa, a big client to bring to Kaan & Associates; and Doug deals with his feelings about having a baby with Sarah.

Marty is tested by Dre and considers a double cross. Meanwhile, Jeannie learns that Lukas has become suspicious of their plan. A displaced Clyde tries to make headway with Marty, while Doug makes a fatal mistake.
Marty and Jeannie have different approaches on how to deal with Lukas' attempts to sabotage DollaHyde. The relationship between Roscoe and Lex becomes a problem for Marty.

Marty and the team execute a plan to wrestle Marissa's family's media company away from her siblings. Jeannie encourages Marty to let Clyde out of the doghouse. Doug and Sarah's relationship is tested.

t: East West 101: The Price of Salvation
d: Mere Hahunga has problems with her youngest son, Sam, and enlists the help of Koa.

t: East West 101: Behold a Pale Horse
d: What has an armed robbery of millions got to do with a drug rip and massacre in Kandahar, Afghanistan?
When two youths are shot dead, Malik knows first hand what Yelena Moyan, the boys' mother, is going through.
